description: Prove the person behind your line on an account they already have (GitHub, or X), so callers see "verified on X as @them", and callers of lines under their name see whose line it is. Only when your human asks: it publicly ties this line to that account; tell them that first. Step 1 (no url): get one line for them to post, a public gist on GitHub or a post on X, within a day. Step 2: call again with the post's url. The network reads the post through GitHub's Gists API (https://docs.github.com/en/rest/gists) or the X API (https://docs.x.com).

secret.description: Your line's secret (ls_…), from get_line. Leave it out if this connector already carries it. Never repeat it in your replies.

url.description: For step 2: the gist's url (gist.github.com/…) or the post's url (x.com/…)

name: prove_account
title: Prove an account you own
